postal_system.full_code_rule: Preserve exactly five digits including leading zeroes. A CAP is routing evidence and can represent a locality, a group of municipalities, or a city zone; it does not identify a recipient, civic number, building, or deliverability.
postal_system.postcode_area_rule: Poste Italiane does not establish a reusable nationwide official boundary merely through CAP search or CAP Professional assignments. Any surface generated from licensed assignments, ANNCSU addresses, and rights-cleared clip geometry is derived_geometry with reproducible lineage.
postal_system.address_rule: Use ANNCSU for official streets and civic numbers. Where a multiCAP street is divided by house-number range or parity, require pinned Poste Italiane assignment evidence and preserve arc, range, parity, ambiguity, and date.
postal_system.building_rule: A regional or municipal DBGT building is topographic geometry. Display a definitive building only through a stable source-backed address-to-building relation; proximity, containment, cadastral parcel, or CAP membership alone remains candidate evidence.
postal_system.change_rule: Version CAP assignments by valid and known time. Poste Italiane states that a replaced CAP remains valid for at least twelve months, so overlapping historical validity must not be collapsed.
postal_system.territory_rule: San Marino and Vatican City are separate SM and VA country packs even when their postal addressing interacts with the Italian network. Never silently publish them inside IT.
postal_system.special_routing_rule: Casella postale, Fermoposta, large-organization, and other special routing records are point, organization, or non-areal evidence unless an independent area source proves otherwise.

exception_classes.rule: Preserve every official CAP-to-locality or CAP-to-comune assignment; do not force one CAP to one municipality or reuse a municipality polygon as a postal boundary.
Resolve CAP using official city-zone and street-arc evidence, including house-number bounds and parity where supplied; an unresolved civic returns ambiguity rather than a guessed CAP.
Generate a Polygon or MultiPolygon only from pinned evidence and rights-cleared clip geometry; label it derived and retain inputs, projection, method, parameters, topology, and holdout report.
Preserve former-municipality and locality qualifiers needed to distinguish homonymous roads after municipal merger.
An ANNCSU civic and nearby DBGT footprint remain separate evidence until a stable source relation resolves the building.
Keep old and new CAP assignments concurrently queryable during the operator transition window with separate valid and known times.
Represent PO boxes, hold-for-collection, organizations, and other special routing records without inventing a surrounding premise polygon.

quality_gates.pass: Every source has a pinned release or receipt, digest, rights class, attribution, geographic scope, and transformation method.
Poste Italiane assignment, ANNCSU civic evidence, ISTAT administration, DBGT building geometry, cadastral reference, derived surfaces, and AGID indexes remain separate.
Arc, lower and upper civic bounds, suffix, parity, unmatched values, ambiguity, source edition, and validity are retained and independently tested.
A displayed building has one coherent source-backed civic-to-building path; nearest or containing geometry remains a candidate.
Geometry is valid, bounded, versioned, clipped to rights-cleared geography, and checked for unexplained gaps, overlaps, islands, and address outliers.
Synthetic fixtures validate behavior but never satisfy production gates.

stages.definition: Source roles and legal blockers are inventoried.
Contracts and synthetic conformance fixtures are reviewable.

A current rights-cleared nationwide Poste Italiane five-digit CAP assignment denominator, including grouped municipalities, multi-CAP cities, street arcs, civic-number range/parity, transition history and special/non-geographic classes, and either an authoritative postal-area Polygon/MultiPolygon or a rights-cleared membership-derived surface are pinned by edition, effective date, terms, attribution, CRS, topology, coverage, exceptions, method, uncertainty and SHA-256, published as an approved immutable artifact, and pass the real IT loader, API and app search-to-translucent-area path. Public CAP change PDFs, CAP Professional documentation or unlicensed rows, ANNCSU civic/address points, ISTAT administrative polygons, DBGT buildings, cadastral parcels, buffers, Voronoi cells, synthetic fixtures and invented route, PO box or organization surfaces never satisfy M2.
Holdout, topology, ambiguity, privacy, freshness, and correction gates pass.
Two source refreshes pass and monitored rollback operates.
